title: blemees-workflow HCP catalog
description: Schema for `*-hcps.json` files. One catalog per process. Cross-reference checks against the state machine (`gate_name` matches a `hitl: true` transition's `gate`, source/destinations exist, etc.) run in `workflow validate`.

process.description: Optional process name. Defaults to the file stem with `-hcps` stripped.

hcps.description: Catalogued Human Control Points (gates) for this process.

gate_name.description: Unique gate identifier. Referenced by `gate` on `hitl: true` transitions in the state machine, and by `control_point` in trust grants.

source.description: State id where the gated transition originates.

destinations.description: State ids the gate lands on. Verdict-style HCPs have multiple entries.

triggering_role.description: Role id that triggers the gate (typically by acting from `source`).

type.description: HCP type per hitl-principles.md. `taste` is an alias for `judgment`.

allowed_levels.description: Which gating levels this HCP supports.

default_level.description: Gating level applied when no trust grant overrides. Must be present in `allowed_levels` (enforced by parser).

agent_prepares.description: Path to / pointer at the packet template the agent prepares before invoking the gate. Optional.

rationale.description: Either an inline one-line rationale or a filename pointing at a sidecar markdown (e.g., `<gate>-rationale.md`). Stored as-is.
